name: UnderLOVEtale
source:
UnderLOVETale, an Undertale Visual Novel Dating Sim!! This plays like a lot of my other dating sims, and you walk around different rooms talking and interacting with characters from Undertale. Try and see if you can find true love!! Enjoy this silly little April Fool's game.

You've stumbled upon the world of Undertale, you get 30 Days to build up love for the characters and get to 100%! You'll have to talk to them, answer their questions, and build up love!
